newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on retail selling.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are seen falling further on Monday as investors seek funds to bid for forthcoming initial public offerings (IPOs), brokers said.

"The investors may sell their shares to bid for new IPOs and repay bank loans," said broker Shakil Rizvi. Brokers said more than 250 million taka worth of IPOs would be released by five companies in July and August.
Brokers said the investors were also under pressure to repay outstanding bank loans worth about 500 million taka. Share prices may fall across the board, they said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 24.11 points or 2.19 percent at 1,074.24 on turnover of 39.4 million taka on Sunday.
